description: This file contains the server-side code for the Dashboard page of an online examination system. It handles page load and button click events to transfer users to different pages such as user profile, leaderboard, start exam, and login.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Dashboard webpage, derived from System.Web.UI.Page, handling user interactions such as button clicks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the UserProfile.aspx page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transers the user to the Leaderboard.aspx page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the StartExam.aspx page to begin an exam.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the LoginPage.aspx.
